query: WITH CitizenAges AS (/* Get citizens with their birth dates */ SELECT d.id, d.birth_date FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala AS d WHERE d.person_type = 'Saudi' AND d.person_status = 'صالح' AND NOT d.birth_date IS NULL AND d.birth_date > '1900-01-01'), HigherEducation AS (/* Citizens with higher degrees (Master, PhD, Fellowship) */ SELECT DISTINCT g.id FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala AS g WHERE g.qualification IN ('ماجستير', 'دكتوراه', 'زمالة')), NonHigherEducation AS (/* Citizens with Bachelor or below (no higher degrees) */ SELECT DISTINCT g.id FROM estishraf_llm_university_graduates_impala AS g WHERE g.qualification IN ('بكالوريوس', 'دبلوم متوسط', 'دبلوم عالي')), ViolationsWithAge AS (/* Get violations with age at time of incident */ SELECT t.violator_id, t.gdate_happened, c.birth_date, FLOOR(DATEDIFF(t.gdate_happened, c.birth_date) / 365.25) AS age_at_violation FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation AS t JOIN CitizenAges AS c ON CAST(t.violator_id AS BIGINT) = c.id WHERE t.gdate_happened BETWEEN '2023-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' AND t.status_description <> CONCAT('Cancelled due to the violator', 's death')), HigherDegreeViolations AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS unique_violators FROM ViolationsWithAge AS v JOIN HigherEducation AS h ON v.violator_id = h.id WHERE v.age_at_violation BETWEEN 30 AND 50), NonHigherViolations AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_violations, COUNT(DISTINCT violator_id) AS unique_violators FROM ViolationsWithAge AS v JOIN NonHigherEducation AS n ON v.violator_id = n.id WHERE v.age_at_violation BETWEEN 30 AND 50), HigherEducationPopulation /* Get total population counts for each education group (age 30-50) */ AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS pop_count FROM CitizenAges AS c JOIN HigherEducation AS h ON c.id = h.id WHERE FLOOR(DATEDIFF('2025-01-01', c.birth_date) / 365.25) BETWEEN 30 AND 50), NonHigherEducationPopulation AS (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS pop_count FROM CitizenAges AS c JOIN NonHigherEducation AS n ON c.id = n.id WHERE FLOOR(DATEDIFF('2025-01-01', c.birth_date) / 365.25) BETWEEN 30 AND 50) SELECT 'الحاصلون على شهادات عليا (ماجستير-دكتوراه)' AS education_group, COALESCE(h.total_violations, 0) AS total_violations, COALESCE(h.unique_violators, 0) AS unique_violators, COALESCE(hp.pop_count, 0) AS population_30_50, ROUND(COALESCE(h.total_violations, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(hp.pop_count, 0), 0), 3) AS violations_per_person FROM HigherDegreeViolations AS h CROSS JOIN HigherEducationPopulation AS hp UNION ALL SELECT 'الخريجون بدون شهادات عليا' AS education_group, COALESCE(n.total_violations, 0) AS total_violations, COALESCE(n.unique_violators, 0) AS unique_violators, COALESCE(np.pop_count, 0) AS population_30_50, ROUND(COALESCE(n.total_violations, 0) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COALESCE(np.pop_count, 0), 0), 3) AS violations_per_person FROM NonHigherViolations AS n CROSS JOIN NonHigherEducationPopulation AS np LIMIT 1200
raw_question: مقارنة المخالفات المرورية حسب المؤهل العلمي للمواطنين (30-50 سنة)
